lots.condition: Front looks clean. Back: pale green-yellow glue residue around the pin-bar rivet, so the pin fitting may have been re-glued or repaired.
lots.key_photo_findings: Enlarged photo 2: the V-shaped pin bar carries the heat-stamped mark, 'PARIS' legible on the right arm and letters consistent with 'LEA STEIN' on the left. Glue residue around the rivet is the main worry.
